purpose: Teach: 磁気/健在/ピット/地雷/風車/衣類/ふれあい/エキス

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが磁気センサーのおもちゃ買ってこられたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad brought home a toy with a magnetic sensor.
lines.style: Warm, conversational. Light uptick at the end—sharing something she knows will interest him. Unhurried, a little playful.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんのご健在を確かめに行きたい
lines.en: Mom, I want to go check that Grandpa is doing well.
lines.style: Quiet, steady request. Not demanding. The tone of a boy thinking something through and needing to say it. Slight pause before speaking, like he's been sitting with this.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが、レースのピット作業を見せて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says he'll show you how they work on the race cars in the pit.
lines.style: Gentle delivery of good news. Soft emphasis on the offer itself. Voice carries the pleasure of being the messenger. Warm and unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、社会で地雷除去のボランティアの話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, I learned in school today about people who volunteer doing mine removal.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but weighted. He's processing something that struck him. No rush to the words. The tone of a child sharing something that matters.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、オランダの風車のお話、絵本で読みましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's read that picture book about the windmills in the Netherlands together.
lines.style: Soft, inviting. Opening note is gentle. A quiet offer, not a directive. Slight warmth on 'together'—she's including him, not just entertaining him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、衣類を畳むのお手伝いするよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm going to help you fold the clothes.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact offer. A little proud but not boastful. The tone of a boy who's decided to do something helpful. Direct and genuine.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんとふれあいの会に行きましょう
lines.en: Sho, let's go to the community gathering with your grandmother.
lines.style: Warm, gentle invitation. Opening soft but clear. A little anticipatory—she's looking forward to it. Voice suggests this is something special for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんが薬草エキスを煎じてくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandma made me herbal tea and it was really good.
lines.style: Quiet delight. Small, genuine pleasure in his voice. The words come easily—he's sharing something that made him happy. Relaxed, not performed.
